name: zmodel_material_update_cycle_if_needed
description: zModel_Material::UpdateCycleIfNeeded advances a material texture cycle once per video frame tick, clamps non-looping cycles, and wraps negative playback.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zModel material-cycle helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass.
